ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached image shows 9 black dots arranged as an equally spaced 3 by 3 grid, with 3 rows and 3 columns. Reasoning: A three-point set is chosen uniformly from all unordered sets of 3 of the 9 points, so the total number of possible sets is C(9,3)=84. The collinear three-point sets visible in this 3 by 3 grid are the 3 horizontal rows, the 3 vertical columns, and the 2 main diagonals. That gives 3+3+2=8 favorable sets. No other straight line in a 3 by 3 equally spaced point grid contains 3 of the shown points. Therefore the probability is 8/84=2/21.
